summary.text: Vivian E. Cook is an Assemblymember from Jamaica, Queens, who began her Assembly tenure in the 1991-92 legislative session.
Her official biography says she is chair of the Committee on Committees and has served for over 25 years as a Queens County district leader.

paragraphs.text: According to her Assembly biography, Cook was born in Rock Hill, South Carolina, graduated from DeFrans Business Institute and entered the business world.
Her civic role began more than 30 years ago when the Kennedy Airport and airfreight expansion threatened her community.

The biography credits her with securing funding for park and recreation projects, including Baisley Park Extension and Charles R. Drew Memorial Park, and with helping develop affordable housing programs and improved services for senior citizens.
She was appointed chair of the Task Force on Food, Farm and Nutrition Policy in 2000, and her committee assignments include Codes, Housing, Insurance, Rules and Ways and Means.
